metadata.question: Does cropland area in Brazil increase from 2003 to 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS Land Cover (MCD12Q1) or ESA WorldCover for cropland classification - MCD12Q1 is better as it covers 2003-2019 range - Compare 2003 vs 2019 cropland extent in Brazil - Need Brazil boundary geometry 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for yearly land cover products - Filter by land cover class for cropland - IGBP classification: Croplands = 12, Cropland/Natural Vegetation Mosaic = 14 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Cropland area could theoretically be 0 in a small area, but for Brazil this would be B (No increase if area decreased or stayed same) - C1: If no images found for 2003 or 2019 - C2: If valid pixels = 0 after processing (unlikely for Brazil-wide analysis) - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN - A: If 2019 cropland area > 2003 cropland area - B: If 2019 cropland area <= 2003 cropland area ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const brazil = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Brazil')) .geometry(); // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const landcover = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD12Q1') .select('LC_Type1'); // Get 2003 image const lc2003 = landcover.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2003, 2003, 'year')).first(); const lc2019 = landcover.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2019, 2019, 'year')).first(); // Check if images exist const col2003Size = landcover.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2003, 2003, 'year')).size().getInfo(); const col2019Size = landcover.filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2019, 2019, 'year')).size().getInfo(); if (col2003Size === 0 || col2019Size === 0) { console.log(`2003 Images: ${col2003Size}, 2019 Images: ${col2019Size}`); console.log("C1"); return; } console.log(`2003 Images: ${col2003Size}, 2019 Images: ${col2019Size}`); // 3. Processing - Create cropland masks (class 12 = Croplands, 14 = Cropland/Natural Vegetation Mosaic) const cropland2003 = lc2003.eq(12).or(lc2003.eq(14)); const cropland2019 = lc2019.eq(12).or(lc2019.eq(14)); // 4. Calculation - Calculate cropland area in km² const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6); // Convert to km² const area2003Result = cropland2003.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: brazil, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const area2019Result = cropland2019.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: brazil, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Get pixel counts for validation const count2003Result = cropland2003.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: brazil, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const count2019Result = cropland2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: brazil, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const area2003 = area2003Result.get('LC_Type1').getInfo(); const area2019 = area2019Result.get('LC_Type1').getInfo(); const count2003 = count2003Result.get('LC_Type1').getInfo(); const count2019 = count2019Result.get('LC_Type1').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`2003 Cropland Area: ${area2003.toFixed(2)} km² (Pixels: ${count2003})`); console.log(`2019 Cropland Area: ${area2019.toFixed(2)} km² (Pixels: ${count2019})`); if (count2003 === 0 || count2019 === 0) { console.log("No valid cropland pixels found."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (area2003 === null || area2019 === null || isNaN(area2003) || isNaN(area2019)) { console.log("Calculation failed (null or NaN result)."); console.log("C3"); return; } const change = area2019 - area2003; const percentChange = ((change / area2003) * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`Change: ${change.toFixed(2)} km² (${percentChange}%)`); if (area2019 > area2003) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
